There’s been a lot of news and warnings this week about AI. And I think it’s fair to ask whether Congress is asleep at the wheel as we hurtle towards AGI and the unknown.

AI experts and industry executives are delivering a clear message — the risks of quickly evolving frontier AI pose serious threats to our safety and the future of our society. We must heed their call, and we can’t wait.
